title: Intellectual Property Assignment
text: Creator hereby assigns all worldwide right, title, and interest in and to Deliverables upon final milestone settlement.

title: Promotional Disclosure Clause
text: Creator must prominently display promotional disclosure (#Ad, #Sponsored) at beginning of all published content in accordance with FTC guidelines.

title: Category Exclusivity Window
text: Creator shall not endorse direct audio tech competitors for 30 days post-launch.

title: Milestone Disbursement Terms
text: Compensation shall be released in accordance with the milestone schedule upon written verification of deliverable metrics.

title: Termination for Cause
text: Either party may terminate agreement immediately if deliverables contain defamatory or copyright infringing materials.

title: Dispute Resolution and Arbitration
text: Any dispute arising under this agreement shall be settled through binding commercial arbitration in Bengaluru, Karnataka.
